reason: The save `.then` at app/assets/javascripts/discourse/controllers/preferences.js.es6:117-123 only sets the current user's `name` and `model.bio_cooked`, and `User#save` (models/user.js.es6:209-214) copies only `bio_excerpt` from the response, so `model.website_name` (now rendered in templates/user/user.hbs:66-71) stays stale after the website is edited.
